关键词: Office Supplies, Stationery, and Gift Stores
Lumber and Other Construction Materials Wholesalers
主要内容: During the 2009-2010 recession, the travel accommodation industry saw a -0.23% sales decline as consumers cut travel spending, leading to reduced hotel check-ins. The office supplies, stationery, and gift stores sector also declined by -0.40% due to decreased business and consumer purchases. In the printing and related support activities subsector, sales fell by -0.49% from 2009 to 2010. Other Motor Vehicle Dealers experienced a -2.59% sales decline from 2009 to 2010 due to reduced consumer spending on large-ticket items during economic uncertainty. Lumber and Other Construction Materials Wholesalers saw a -3.07% sales drop, as construction projects slowed, reducing demand for building materials. Home Furnishings Stores also faced a -3.27% sales decline, as fewer home constructions led to decreased demand for home decor and goods. The building material and supplies dealers industry was the hardest hit during the recession. Sageworks’ data indicates that tangential industries, such as lumber dealers, also experienced a decline in sales during both 2009 and 2010. The reduction in construction projects led to contractors purchasing fewer supplies, which significantly impacted the industry. Sales % Change from 2009 to 2010: -3.28%.
